heading: Thursday, June 5, 2025
topLine: Alibaba releases Qwen3 Embedding and Reranker models.

items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen3 Embedding and Reranker models
items.summary: Qwen3-Embedding and Qwen3-Reranker (0.6B, 4B, 8B) are Apache 2.0 open-weight text embedding and reranking models. Qwen reports the 8B embedding model ranked first on the MTEB multilingual leaderboard with a score of 70.58 as of release.
